transcript.statement: The safety and reliability of the bookkeeping system are paramount to ensure data integrity and prevent financial discrepancies. Requirements SAF-01, SAF-02, and SAF-03 are foundational for accurate and reliable financial tracking. SAF-04 and SAF-05 ensure that users have access to essential functionalities even during faults, while SAF-06 and SAF-07 provide mechanisms to validate operations and protect data. Without these, the system risks data loss and corruption, undermining trust in financial reporting.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is critical for a bookkeeping system to ensure users can access and process financial data quickly and effectively. transcript.statement: The ethical and compliance aspects are crucial for the bookkeeping system to ensure accountability and fairness in financial reporting. RES-05 supports compliance with accounting standards, and RES-06 allows for confidential reporting of ethical concerns, fostering social responsibility. RES-07 ensures fairness in multi-currency transactions, which is critical in a globalized economy.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions, retaining records for at least 5 years.
The system shall provide a multi-tiered error handling system prioritizing critical transactions while ensuring overall safety.
The system shall maintain user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms that meet performance requirements.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement caching methods that reduce energy usage while maintaining performance.
